modules.module_title: Taking charge of shift from Warper-Direct Warping Machine

pcs.pc_description: come at least 10 - 15 minutes earlier to the work spot
Check for the necessary items like chalk, pen, knife etc.
meet the previous shift warper, discuss with him/ her regarding the issues faced by him/ her with respect to the quality, production, spare, safety or any other specific instruction etc.
check the condition of the running beams, machine, performance of the yarn running on machine
check whether all the stop motions are in good working condition
take job cards for the next programs, from your superior
check availability of the cones/ cheeses & empty warping beams required for the next programs .
check cleanliness of the machines & other work areas.
check whether any spare/raw material/ tool or any other material is thrown under the machines or in the other work areas.
question the previous shift warper for any deviation in the above and bring the same to the knowledge of his/ her shift superior as well as that of the previous shift
take over the shift from the outgoing warper in a proper manner

modules.module_title: Handing over the Shift to Warper Direct Warping Machine

pcs.pc_description: hand over the shift to the incoming warper in a proper manner & get clearance from the incoming counterpart before leaving the work spot.

report to his/ her shift superiors as well as that of the incoming shift, in case his/ her counterpart doesn't report for work. in such cases, the shift has to be properly handed over to the incoming shift superior & get clearance from him/ her before leaving the work spot.

report to his/ her shift superior about the quality / production / safety issues or any other issue faced in his/ her shift and should leave the department only after getting concurrence for the same from his/ her superiors

pcs.pc_description: make tiny & firm warper's knots
takeout the broken end in the warping beam.
knot the broken end with the broken end in the creel, using tiny & firm warper knot by hand or by the knotting machine provided.
start the machine & run at slow speed for some time before increasing the machine speed
record the warp breakages details in the yarn performance book

modules.module_title: Creeling Of Cones/ Cheeses in the Warping Creel

pcs.pc_description: remove the run out cones/ cheeses of the previous program.
collect the removed cones/cheeses in trolleys/ bags provided for it
pack the collected cones/ cheeses as per the instructions given
write the following details on the packed bags: a) Count details, b) Mill Name, c) Warping Set No., d) No. Of Cones, e) Gross wt. in kgs, f) Net Wt. in Kgs
clean the warping creel area & the warping machine thoroughly
bring the yarn bags required for the next program and keep the same in middle of the warping creel
bring the empty trolleys provided to store empty polythene bags cone inserts and keep the same in the middle of the warping creel
remove the polythene bags, cone inserts etc.& store the same in the respective trolleys provided
creel the cones/ cheeses in the creel stand
remove the trolleys of empty polythene covers & cone inserts from the warping area.
check the stop motions & to ensure they are in on position, before starting the machine
check the counter meter& set it to zero
mount the empty warping beam in the machine
set the beam meters in the counter meter
record the beam no, no. of ends, beam set meters etc. in the job card before starting the machine
switch on the warping drum so as to ensure no deviation between the beam set meters& the actual beam meters
ensure that the ends in both the edges are coming properly without any overlapping. If so, it has to be corrected using warping comb.
there should not be any up & downor wavy portion in the warping beam, particularly in the edges.
stop the machine & doff the warped beam as soon as the set length of yarn is achieved
note down the following details on the warped beams using chalk, a. Yarn Count, b. Warp Set No., c. Warp Beam No., d. No. of Ends, e. Beam Meters
